summary: Nightly QA trigger scheduled in Claude's scheduler (per design decision — NOT daemon cron). Task id nightly-orchestrator-qa, cron "0 2 * * *" (daily 02:00 local; scheduler adds ~9min jitter → ~02:09), stored at ~/.claude/scheduled-tasks/nightly-orchestrator-qa/SKILL.md. Prompt is fully self-contained: run self-learn-qa skill (~/.claude/orchestrator/skills/self-learn-qa/SKILL.md) against :8787 under a 100k hard token budget, nightly QA ONLY (no heartbeat/unrelated work), claim-or-create "Nightly QA run <date>" task, ADD-only/flake/≤5-problems rules restated, stop when skill says stop. Pre-flight guard: if daemon unreachable OR /graph/delta 404s → record nothing, touch nothing, exit with a note. Verified: list_scheduled_tasks read-back (cron + prompt correct, enabled), skill file + graph_delta (mcp-core.js:71, daemon.js:1088) exist, AND live :8787 already serves /graph/delta (HTTP 200, real delta JSON) — daemon was restarted by another session, so first armed run is live tomorrow ~02:09. Caveats: runs only while the Claude app is open (else fires on next launch); recommend one manual "Run now" to pre-approve tool permissions so the unattended 2 AM run doesn't stall on prompts. No files touched in ~/.claude/orchestrator.
